objective: Deliver A-020 Human Gate Phase 1 as an offline fail-closed validator that binds a structured decision and attestation claim to an exact task, gate, reviewed HEAD, artifact hash, evidence reference, independent principal, and required role while keeping every approval non-authorizing until a trusted authority resolver exists.
non_goals: Do not resolve or authenticate GitHub identity
Do not set can_authorize=true or grant merge, deployment, research, trade, or production authority
Do not treat model output, chat text, usernames, caller-supplied mappings, hashes, or credentials as human approval
Do not call providers, GitHub, or any network service
Do not wire H7, Policy, Context, Router, Executor, Memory, production state, or GitHub writes
reviewer: Reed or Simon, with Junyan final review
input_contracts: HumanGateContext with exact current HEAD, reviewed artifact hash, executor identity, and required authority role
output_artifacts: Deterministic HUMAN_GATE_BLOCKED result for every APPROVE while AUTHORITY_RESOLVER_UNWIRED
Non-authorizing UNVERIFIED_DECISION_RECORDED result for valid REVISE, REJECT, DEFER, and RETIRE
Closed schemas, offline adversarial regressions, mutation cases, and CI registration
